notes: The ASV inverts ἐγένετο ἐπ᾽ αὐτὸν ἔκστασις into 'he fell into a trance'; giving 'he' to αὐτόν under rule 15 is right, since the competing reading (supplied subject on ἐγένετο) would leave αὐτόν with no English word at all.
παρασκευαζόντων takes the supplied subordinator it licenses under rule 86 and heads on 'ready' as the meaning-bearing complement.
